# OpsDeck

> Field operations platform for UK trades firms with operatives out in the field. Runs the whole operation from one place — enquiries and quotes, job files, crew and vehicle allocation, job details on operatives' phones, PPE checks and declarations, site handovers, photos and notes to the office, a live calendar and invoice flags. Built in Sheffield. Running Hi-Point Access's scaffolding operation. From £250/month for 1–10 operatives, unlimited users.

OpsDeck lets the owner and office of a trades firm oversee every job from a phone, tablet or computer — without hiring another ops manager to keep track of the work. Each build is configured to how the firm already operates, then supported monthly by the founder, Rob France. OpsDeck also offers smaller admin and quoting tools and fixed-price done-for-you services for trades businesses.

## Field Ops Platform (main product)

- [Field Ops Platform](https://opsdeck.co.uk/platform-build) — what it does:
  - Enquiries and quotes for private, commercial and one-off work; accepted quotes become jobs automatically
  - Council and framework jobs created alongside private work, with documents attached to the job file
  - Job file from enquiry to completion, moving through clear stages
  - Surveys allocated to staff; jobs allocated to operatives and vehicles
  - Job link sent to each operative by WhatsApp — no app to install, no training, and operatives only see their own job, not office data
  - PPE check and signed declaration required before the job opens — timestamped
  - Handover filled in and signed on site, emailed to the customer automatically
  - Site photos and notes sent straight to the right job in the office
  - Live calendar of jobs, crews and vehicles; jobs turn green when completed
  - Invoice flag when a job is done, showing what to invoice and how much, with records kept
  - Toolbox talks, RAMS, method statements, training and messages sent to all staff in one click, with signed declarations — replacing WhatsApp groups
  - Vehicle checks, MOTs and staff holidays tracked
  - For scaffolding: hire weeks tracked and overrunning hires flagged
- Pricing: monthly fee banded by number of field operatives, unlimited users — 1–10 £250, 11–20 £325, 21–30 £400, 31–40 £475, 41–50 £550, 50+ from £550 scoped on call. Build fee from £1,500, fixed in writing after a scoping call. Monthly fee starts from go-live. Rolling monthly, 30 days' notice, no annual contract.

## Smaller platform tiers

- AI Tools and Automation — £75/month, setup from £200. One specific admin task automated.
- Quote Builder — £100/month, setup from £300. Voice or manual quoting with adaptive memory.
- Quote Builder + Dashboard — £150/month, setup from £300. Quoting plus enquiries, jobs, calendar, sales and profit forecasting.
- Unlimited users included on every tier.

## Who We Serve

UK trades firms with operatives out in the field and an office keeping track of them: scaffolding, tarmac and surfacing, groundworks, roofing, insulation, fencing and landscaping. Best suited to firms that have outgrown spreadsheets, diaries and WhatsApp groups, where the owner or office spends the day chasing what has been done.

## Proven Results

- Hi-Point Access Ltd (Sheffield scaffolding and access, council frameworks and private contracts): whole operation runs on the OpsDeck Field Ops Platform — one job file from enquiry to completion, site photos straight onto the right job, handovers signed digitally on site, foremen marking work complete from site, and the full council compliance pack downloading in one click.
- Birdwell Insulation Ltd: reduced quote turnaround from 15 minutes per quote done in batches to 30 seconds per quote using a bespoke Excel-to-document converter.
- Infascape Ltd: OpsDeck used daily in an active Sheffield landscaping business.
